Class Team

java.lang.Object
com.project.hackhub.model.team.Team
@Entity public class Team extends Object

      public Team(@NonNull @NonNull String name, @NonNull @NonNull Hackathon hackathon, @NonNull @NonNull User teamLeader)
      Costruisce un nuovo team con nome, hackathon di riferimento e team leader.
      Parameters:
      name - il nome del team
      hackathon - l'hackathon di riferimento
      teamLeader - l'utente designato come leader

      public void addTeamMember(User u)
      Adds a User to the team members list.
      Parameters:
      u - the user to add; cannot be null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the user is null
      IllegalStateException - if the user is already in the team or if the maximum team size has been reached
